title: Pagans named Zeus from living — τῷ ζῆν
source_text: XX. Hinc etiam Ethnici Deum illum supremum quem ipsi praedicabant patrem hominumque Deumque, vocaverunt Ζῆνα quasi vivum diceres, scilicet a τῷ ζῆν, quod apud Graecos vivere significat.
pass_a_gloss: Hence also the pagans called that supreme God whom they proclaimed father of men and God, Ζῆνα, as if you should say the living One, namely from τῷ ζῆν, which among the Greeks means to live.
pass_b_english: Even pagans nicknamed the top god from living.
Ζῆνα from τῷ ζῆν — to live.
Echoes the living-God theme outside Israel.
